claims.text: Updating a collection that already has indexes (e.g. changing its rules or other options while resubmitting the same indexes) succeeds instead of failing with an 'index already exists' error, and the indexes are preserved.
Updating a collection's indexes list (adding, changing or removing an index) succeeds and the collection reports exactly the new set of indexes.
A unique index kept across a collection update is still enforced on records afterwards.
